frases.dice: A seven billion parameter model weighs twenty-eight gigabytes in FP32. Fourteen in BF16. And seven in FP8.
frases.muestra: A 7-billion-parameter model weighs 28 GB in FP32, 14 in BF16, and 7 in FP8.
frases.es: Un modelo de 7.000 millones de parámetros pesa 28 GB en FP32, 14 en BF16 y 7 en FP8.

frases.dice: It's all about how each number is stored.
frases.muestra: It's all about how each number is stored.
frases.es: La diferencia está en cómo se guarda cada número.

frases.dice: Data Scientist twenty twenty-seven, stage one: tensors and PyTorch internals.
frases.muestra: Data Scientist 2027, stage 1: tensors and PyTorch internals.
frases.es: Data Scientist 2027, etapa 1: tensores y PyTorch por dentro.

frases.dice: A tensor isn't a table. It's a flat block of memory, plus a recipe to walk it: the strides.
frases.muestra: A tensor isn't a table: it's a flat block of memory plus a recipe to walk it, the strides.
frases.es: Un tensor no es una tabla: es un bloque plano de memoria, más una receta para recorrerlo, los strides.

frases.dice: In a two by three FP32 matrix, moving down a row skips twelve bytes. Moving across a column, four.
frases.muestra: In a 2×3 FP32 matrix, moving down a row skips 12 bytes; moving across a column, 4.
frases.es: En una matriz de 2×3 en FP32, bajar una fila salta 12 bytes, y avanzar una columna, 4.

frases.dice: An element's address is the base, plus each index times its stride. Transposing copies nothing: it just swaps the strides, so the result isn't contiguous.
frases.muestra: An element's address is the base plus each index times its stride. Transposing copies nothing: it just swaps the strides, so the result isn't contiguous.
frases.es: La dirección de cada elemento es la base más cada índice por su stride. Transponer no copia nada: solo intercambia los strides, y el resultado deja de ser contiguo.

frases.dice: Autograd: PyTorch records each operation in a graph, and backward walks it in reverse with the chain rule.
frases.muestra: Autograd: PyTorch records each operation in a graph, and backward walks it in reverse with the chain rule.
frases.es: Autograd: PyTorch anota cada operación en un grafo, y backward lo recorre al revés con la regla de la cadena.

frases.dice: Reverse mode gets millions of derivatives for the cost of one forward pass. Forward mode would need one pass per parameter.
frases.muestra: Reverse mode gets millions of derivatives for the cost of one forward pass. Forward mode would need one pass per parameter.
frases.es: El modo inverso obtiene millones de derivadas por el costo de una pasada hacia adelante. El modo directo necesitaría una pasada por parámetro.

frases.dice: For a custom gradient, you write your own forward and backward.
frases.muestra: For a custom gradient, you write your own forward and backward.
frases.es: Para un gradiente a medida, defines tu propia función con su forward y su backward.

frases.dice: On a GPU, memory is a pyramid: registers, shared memory, L2 cache, HBM. Lower is bigger, and slower.
frases.muestra: On a GPU, memory is a pyramid: registers, shared memory, L2 cache, HBM. Lower is bigger and slower.
frases.es: En la GPU, la memoria es una pirámide: registros, memoria compartida, caché L2 y HBM. Más abajo, más grande y más lenta.

frases.dice: An H100 does nine hundred eighty-nine teraflops in BF16, but its memory delivers three point three five terabytes per second.
frases.muestra: An H100 does 989 teraflops in BF16, but its memory delivers 3.35 terabytes per second.
frases.es: Una H100 hace 989 billones de operaciones por segundo en BF16, pero su memoria entrega 3,35 terabytes por segundo.

frases.dice: So you need about two hundred ninety-five operations per byte you read. That's arithmetic intensity, the core of the roofline model.
frases.muestra: So you need about 295 operations per byte you read. That's arithmetic intensity, the core of the roofline model.
frases.es: Para no esperar datos, necesitas unas 295 operaciones por cada byte que lees. Esa razón es la intensidad aritmética, la base del modelo roofline.

frases.dice: An element-wise add does one sixth of an operation per byte: memory-bound. A large matrix multiply does over a thousand: compute-bound.
frases.muestra: An element-wise add does 1/6 of an operation per byte: memory-bound. A 4096 matrix multiply does over a thousand: compute-bound.
frases.es: Una suma elemento a elemento hace 1/6 de operación por byte: la limita la memoria. Una multiplicación de matrices de 4096 hace más de mil: la limita el cómputo.

frases.dice: That's why we fuse operators. Three element-wise operations each read and write memory: six trips.
frases.muestra: That's why we fuse operators. Three element-wise ops each read and write memory: six trips.
frases.es: Por eso se fusionan operadores. Tres operaciones elemento a elemento leen y escriben en memoria: seis viajes.

frases.dice: Fused into one kernel: two trips, three times less traffic. That's torch dot compile, and the idea behind FlashAttention.
frases.muestra: Fused into one kernel: two trips, 3× less traffic. That's torch.compile, and the idea behind FlashAttention.
frases.es: Fusionadas en un solo kernel son dos viajes: tres veces menos tráfico. Es lo que hace torch.compile, y la idea detrás de FlashAttention.

frases.dice: Now, what is the mantissa? A floating point number is stored as a sign, times a mantissa, times two to the power of an exponent.
frases.muestra: What is the mantissa? A floating-point number is stored as sign × mantissa × 2 to the exponent.
frases.es: ¿Qué es la mantisa? Un número de punto flotante se guarda como signo × mantisa × 2 elevado al exponente.

frases.dice: The exponent sets the scale. The mantissa holds the significant digits: the precision.
frases.muestra: The exponent sets the scale. The mantissa holds the significant digits: the precision.
frases.es: El exponente da la escala: qué tan grande o pequeño puede ser. La mantisa guarda los dígitos significativos: la precisión.

frases.dice: For example, pi in FP32 is three point one four one five nine three. In BF16, with only seven mantissa bits, it becomes three point one four zero six.
frases.muestra: For example, π in FP32 is 3.141593. In BF16, with only 7 mantissa bits, it becomes 3.1406.
frases.es: Por ejemplo, π en FP32 es 3,141593. Con los 7 bits de mantisa de BF16, queda en 3,1406.

frases.dice: FP means floating point. FP32 has eight exponent bits and twenty-three mantissa bits. BF16, brain floating point, keeps the eight exponent bits, and leaves seven for the mantissa: same range, less precision.
frases.muestra: FP means floating point. FP32 has 8 exponent bits and 23 mantissa bits. BF16 (brain floating point) keeps the 8 exponent bits and leaves 7 for the mantissa: same range, less precision.
frases.es: FP significa floating point. FP32 usa 8 bits de exponente y 23 de mantisa. BF16 (brain floating point) conserva los 8 de exponente y deja 7 de mantisa: el mismo rango, con menos precisión.

frases.dice: FP16 has more mantissa but less exponent: its maximum is sixty-five thousand five hundred four, so you need loss scaling.
frases.muestra: FP16 has more mantissa but less exponent: its max is 65,504, so you need loss scaling.
frases.es: FP16 tiene más mantisa pero menos exponente: su máximo es 65.504, y por eso hay que escalar la pérdida.

frases.dice: FP8 is floating point in eight bits. The name gives the split: E5M2 is five exponent and two mantissa bits, for gradients. E4M3 is four and three, for weights and activations.
frases.muestra: FP8 is floating point in 8 bits. The name gives the split: E5M2 is 5 exponent and 2 mantissa bits, for gradients. E4M3 is 4 and 3, for weights and activations.
frases.es: FP8 es punto flotante en solo 8 bits. El nombre dice el reparto: E5M2 son 5 bits de exponente y 2 de mantisa, para gradientes. E4M3 son 4 y 3, para pesos y activaciones.

frases.dice: On Google Cloud, TPUs compute in BF16 and accumulate in FP32. And A3 machines with H100s train in FP8 precision.
frases.muestra: On Google Cloud, TPUs compute in BF16 and accumulate in FP32. A3 machines with H100s train in FP8.
frases.es: En Google Cloud, las TPU multiplican en BF16 y acumulan en FP32. Y las máquinas A3, con H100, entrenan en FP8.

frases.dice: The basics: transposing doesn't copy. Low intensity is memory-bound, so fuse. And BF16 rarely needs loss scaling: it has FP32's range.
frases.muestra: The basics: transposing doesn't copy. Low intensity is memory-bound, so fuse. And BF16 rarely needs loss scaling: it has FP32's range.
frases.es: Con esto tienes las bases: transponer no copia, porque solo cambian los strides. Con intensidad baja, manda la memoria: fusiona. Y BF16 no escala la pérdida, porque tiene el rango de FP32.

frases.muestra: Next: data curation and synthetic pipelines. Share and follow.
